name: ecorex-desktop
description: EcoreX desktop application with a local agent runtime
author: EcoreX

scripts.dev:electron: wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && npm run build:electron && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron .
scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron
scripts.package:dir: npm run build && npm run stage:runtime:win && electron-builder --dir --publish never
scripts.package:win: npm run build && npm run stage:runtime:win && electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.package:win:signed: npm run sign:win:preflight && npm run build && npm run stage:runtime:win && electron-builder --win --dir --publish never && npm run sign:win:unpacked && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --prepackaged release/win-unpacked --publish never && npm run sign:win:setup && npm run update-feed:win
scripts.package:mac:all: npm run package:mac:arm64 && npm run package:mac:x64
scripts.package:mac:arm64: npm run build && npm run stage:runtime:mac -- --python-arch arm64 && electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64 --publish never
scripts.package:mac:x64: npm run build && npm run stage:runtime:mac -- --python-arch x64 && electron-builder --mac dmg --x64 --publish never
scripts.sign:win: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/sign-win.ps1 -SignToolDir "C:/脚本签名工具"
scripts.sign:win:preflight: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/sign-win.ps1 -SignToolDir "C:/脚本签名工具" -PreflightOnly
scripts.sign:win:setup: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/sign-win.ps1 -SignToolDir "C:/脚本签名工具" -SetupOnly
scripts.sign:win:unpacked: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/sign-win.ps1 -SignToolDir "C:/脚本签名工具" -ArtifactsDir release/win-unpacked -CoreAppOnly
